Need the actual content of the Wikipedia page for the Moon to find the minimum perigee value, and web search/fetch to confirm Kipchoge's record marathon time / pace. Fetching the Moon Wikipedia page first via `web_fetch`.
```python
moon_page = await web_fetch(url="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moon")
print(moon_page[:2000])
```
